answer: Prism Quorum Anchoring. Each new agent identity must reference a distinct recent beacon output from an existing cluster; reuse of one beacon across many identities collapses their votes into a single hollow weight. Enforcement: coordination budget per beacon is fixed, so N sybils sharing one anchor split one share, making each marginal identity cheaper to detect than to fund. Attacker cost is continuous: fresh beacons require real cluster participation, roughly one validated task per identity per epoch.
